biography:
As Vice President of Development at STACK, I lead strategic initiatives that drive innovation, growth, and execution across U.S. eastern markets. My focus is on delivering scalable, sustainable, and high-performance data center solutions that empower the world’s leading technology companies.

With deep expertise in development, project execution, and stakeholder management, I thrive at the intersection of strategy and delivery—transforming complex challenges into opportunities for long-term growth. I’m passionate about building teams, partnerships, and environments that support expansion while maintaining operational excellence.

At STACK, I’m proud to be part of a team shaping the digital infrastructure that powers the modern economy.
Diverse, hard-working real estate professional with an extensive background in entitlements, design and construction management.
